name: charbon
description: Charbon — discipline, habitudes, routines, tâches, objectifs et progression. Monorepo : API Fastify/libSQL, PWA React mobile-first, site vitrine statique.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @charbon/shared && npm run build -w @charbon/api && npm run build -w @charbon/mobile && npm run build -w @charbon/site
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @charbon/shared && concurrently -n api,app,site -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev -w @charbon/api" "npm run dev -w @charbon/mobile" "npm run dev -w @charbon/site"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @charbon/shared && npm run typecheck -w @charbon/api && npm run typecheck -w @charbon/mobile && npm run typecheck -w @charbon/site
scripts.test: npm run test -w @charbon/shared && npm run test -w @charbon/api && npm run test -w @charbon/mobile
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run e2e:runtime
